title: Off-by-one calendar dates in negative-UTC-offset (Americas) browsers — date-only fields rendered in browser tz
rootCause: Date-only `@db.Date` columns (validFrom/validTo/startDate/endDate/openedAt/hiredAt/weekStart/asOf — prisma/schema.prisma) are serialized by Prisma→Nest as UTC-midnight ISO ('YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00.000Z'). The FE renders them with `new Date(x).toLocaleDateString()`, which formats in the BROWSER timezone → in any negative-offset zone (Americas) UTC-midnight is the previous evening, so the displayed day is shifted back by one. The correct tenant-tz formatter exists (frontend/src/lib/locale.ts buildLocaleFormatters().formatDate via Intl.DateTimeFormat({timeZone}), bound by useLocale()) but is DEAD CODE — `useLocale` has 0 callers across components/routes/features. Backend even serializes the same @db.Date inconsistently (person-profile.service.ts:127 emits 'YYYY-MM-DD'; resource-manager-dashboard-query.service.ts:122 emits full UTC-midnight timestamp) — both off-by-one when fed to new Date().
scope: 39 value-bearing toLocaleDateString/toLocaleString sites; 21 match the new Date(dateField).toLocaleDateString off-by-one pattern; 10 sites are correctly guarded (append 'T00:00:00Z' / getUTCDate — e.g. HrActionCardsPanel.tsx:30, InteractiveGantt, workload-helpers). Concrete unguarded leads: PersonProfilePanel.tsx:152,288; ProjectPositionDetailPage.tsx:490,585,591; MeCasesTab.tsx:126; PersonSidebarDrawer.tsx:160; LeaveDecisionDrawer.tsx:410; LeaveApprovalsPanel.tsx:158.
userImpact: Any user in a negative-UTC-offset timezone sees project start/end dates, skill validity, case opened dates, hire dates, leave dates etc. one day earlier than the true value. Display-only but pervasive and trust-eroding; the team's own test (locale.test.ts:29 uses noon to dodge the boundary) shows it's a known trap left unguarded at ~21 sites.
suggestedFix: Wire the existing tenant-tz formatter: call useLocale()/formatDate(value) at the ~21 unguarded render sites (or a shared <DateText> component), OR for pure date-only values format from the 'YYYY-MM-DD' string directly without new Date() (e.g. parse parts, or append 'T12:00:00'). Also standardize the backend @db.Date serialization to a single 'YYYY-MM-DD' convention. Add an Americas-tz render test.
evidence: grep: 39 toLocaleDateString sites / 21 off-by-one pattern / 0 useLocale callers / 10 guarded; prisma/schema.prisma @db.Date columns; locale.ts (dead formatter); locale.test.ts:29 (noon dodge); person-profile.service.ts:127 vs resource-manager-dashboard-query.service.ts:122 (split serialization).

title: GET /api/projects ignores ALL status filter params server-side → drilldowns cannot filter even with correct params
rootCause: Round-7 live probe: GET /api/projects with ?status=ACTIVE, ?lifecycleStatus=ACTIVE, ?state=ACTIVE, ?statuses=ACTIVE, and even ?status=CLOSED ALL return the same 40 rows. The list endpoint has no server-side status filtering, so every project-list drilldown depends entirely on client-side filtering (which is itself case-sensitive/broken per F-DC-3/SC-3). This compounds SC-3: fixing the FE drilldown params is necessary but NOT sufficient — the backend must honor the filter or the client filter must be correct.
suggestedFix: Add server-side status/rag filtering to GET /api/projects (and verify other list endpoints honor their documented query params), OR ensure the client-side filter is correct and the full list is acceptable to ship. Pairs with SC-3.
evidence: live (director): GET /api/projects?status=ACTIVE → 40 (all); ?status=CLOSED → 40; only 10 are ACTIVE. Also: HR-scoped /api/people, ?lifecycleStatus=ACTIVE, /api/hr/people return error envelopes for hr_manager — HR's own people-query path appears unavailable (worth a separate check).
